[SWS_CM_10341] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP response mes- sage
⌈
The SOME/IP response message for the Set method shall be transmit-
ted using the transport protocol defined by the attribute SomeipServiceInter-
faceDeployment.fieldDeployment.set.transportProtocol in the Manifest.
The SOME/IP response message for the Get method shall be transmitted using
the transport protocol defined by the attribute SomeipServiceInterfaceDeploy-
ment.fieldDeployment.get.transportProtocol respectively.
⌋
